title: Dirac operators for infinite-dimensional color Lie algebras
summary: We develop the Dirac formalism for infinite-dimensional quadratic $\mathbb{Z}$-graded color Lie algebras with finite-dimensional components. Cubic Dirac operators are defined in completions of the quantum Weil algebra determined by the $\mathbb{Z}$-grading. The same grading fixes the normal-ordering convention. Normal ordering introduces a cohomological obstruction to the construction, measured by a color analogue of the Kac-Peterson class.
